headlines.summary: ETFs sold a net $24.5 million of Constellation Energy on Tuesday, Nov. 10.

headlines.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Launched Peak+ Nuclear And Storage Contracts
headlines.summary: Constellation Energy (NasdaqGS: CEG) has introduced Peak+ contracts that bundle nuclear power, battery storage, and demand response into one package. The Peak+ structure targets long term supply deals for large buyers that want cleaner power with more flexible delivery profiles. Constellation has also been named power marketer for Helion’s planned commercial fusion project that intends to serve Microsoft.

headlines.title: How Earnings Beat At Constellation Energy Stock Has Changed Its Investment Story
headlines.summary: Constellation Energy reported Q3 2026 sales of US$9.55b and net income of US$1.84b, with basic EPS from continuing operations of US$5.19. The company also raised full year guidance while affirming its quarterly dividend. The business has secured long dated nuclear power agreements with customers like Amazon and Google. Together with new contract structures such as Peak+, this points to a larger share of earnings tied to multi decade clean power deals.

description: Constellation Energy Corporation produces and sells energy products and services in the United States. The company operates through five segments: Mid-Atlantic, Midwest, New York, ERCOT, and Other Power Regions. It offers electricity, natural gas, energy-related products, and sustainable solutions. The company has approximately 31,676 megawatts of generating capacity consisting of nuclear, wind, solar, natural gas, and hydroelectric assets. It serves distribution utilities, municipalities, cooperatives, and commercial, industrial, public sector, and residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland.
